entry.title: /g/ Technology: Is AGI simply a really advanced indexing software?
entry.content: Intelligence is not a bloated neural network trying to simulate reasoning. If you can index the streaming variables of the physical universe as cleanly, compactly, and directly as Voidtools indexes a hard drive, the data naturally routes itself. You don't need a neural brain to think; the index is the mind.
